part_a.fixed_evaluation_batch: the persisted 40 label-balanced validation probes from posthoc-balanced-probes-20261014T2125
part_a.loss: CrossEntropyLoss mean over the fixed 40-sample batch
part_a.parameter_scope: weight matrix of every hidden Linear layer and the output Linear layer
part_a.gradient_norm: L2/Frobenius norm of dL/dW at the checkpoint
part_a.interpretation_limit: The one-step estimate is local at a checkpoint; displacement is a net endpoint difference. No historical per-step update log exists.

part_b.threshold_policy: No accuracy or gradient threshold is selected post hoc.
part_b.claim_policy: Without a predeclared joint criterion, report INCONCLUSIVE rather than assert coexistence.

part_c.fixed_from_v2: train/validation indices, batch order, width=128, SGD lr=0.01 without momentum, batch=64
part_c.comparison_limit: Compare each follow-up arm only with the corresponding V2 D=12 baseline; do not pool with pilot V1 gain=0.5.

stop_conditions: Stop if a source checkpoint is missing or its SHA-256 differs from checkpoint_manifest.json.
Stop on NaN or Inf in loss, parameter gradients, activation gradients or stored metrics.
Stop before Part C if Parts A/B are incomplete.
Stop at 600 seconds and preserve completed artifacts.
Never overwrite V1, V2, post-hoc or an existing follow-up output directory.
Do not change learning rate, step count, initialization or activation after inspecting results.
ai_assistance: AI implemented bounded measurements and execution support; the researcher owns interpretation and final claims.
